text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day at lunchtime, I found Neo Universe 
in the cafeteria.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Intake" and "recording"... commencing. 
Time to say, "Itadakimasu."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Unfamiliar food items are piled up on Neo 
Universe's table."
choice_data_list: What's this? Where'd you get this?
What's this? Where did this come from?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer. "USF"... Unidentified Space 
Food.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"A mission to find 'bonus food' for Neo 
Universe. Commencing investigation."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe took bites one by one, 
comparing them as she gave her food 
review.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Sample A... viscous texture. Quite 
"DCOMF"...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Sample B is... hmm. NaCl is "overloaded."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Exploration"... No results. Matching 
organic matter... remains unconfirmed.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...Continuing sampling. Toward 
"Eclipse"...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe pulled a new pack of space 
food out of her bag and spread it across 
the table.
choice_data_list: You're going to sample that many?!
You're going to sample that many?!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative. The properties of the 
"spectrum"... are important. Decreased QOL 
has a negative impact on neurons.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Impairs "activity"... There is also a risk 
that responding to "EMGY" will become 
difficult.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...Continuing cruise. Flyby until exact 
performance is determined.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe seemed determined to eat all 
of the space food to assess the taste.
choice_data_list: I've eaten too much, so I'll pass.
Let's eat it all until you're satisfied!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
My central nervous system is nowhere near 
an approximation of "full"... But 
indeed... control is probably necessary.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative. Investigation period has 
reached "ETD"... Next time, then.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without overeating, Neo Universe finished 
comparing the space foods!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Resuming investigation from Sample 
C.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"...Next up, Sample Z. We're at the 
halfway mark... Increasing propulsion 
now."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Neo Universe finished off the 
massive mountain of space food.
